title: Snake
description:
Write the complete logic of Snake, ready to draw with raylib.

```
grid 20x15, snake length 3 at (5, 7) moving right
eat food -> length 4, new food placed on an empty cell
turning back on yourself is ignored
hit a wall or yourself -> game over, score 1
```
hints: Each tick: work out the new head, check walls and the body, push it to the front, and pop the tail unless food was eaten (`push_front` and `pop_back` on the `std::deque`).
When checking the body, the tail cell is allowed when the snake is not growing, because it moves away this tick.
requirements: The snake is a `std::deque` of cells; it moves one cell per tick.
Direction changes take effect on the next tick, and reversing is not allowed.
Food never appears on the snake; use a seeded `std::mt19937`.
stretch: Draw it with raylib: one `DrawRectangle` per cell, at 10 ticks per second.
